text:
Maya (eng-infra): Starting apac-southeast-3 soak + load campaign now. Scope: 24h soak, two 2-hour ramp windows, validate autoscaler behavior, node recovery, and egress constraints. Kickoff checks done, running smoke to warm caches.
Ajay (eng-platform): What's the planned traffic ramp? Do we have a link to the small runbook?
Maya (eng-infra): Ramp plan: 0-15m warmup at 10rps, 15-90m ramp to 600rps, hold 2h, drop to 50% for 30m, second ramp to 900rps for 2h. Runbook: https://internal.docs/redwood/runbooks/apac3-soak (short checklist there).
Diego (eng-ops): GPU pool status: 48 x A10G provisioned, 4 reserved buffer. Note: cloud provider enforces 5 Gbps egress per subnet — we should watch cross-region KV traffic.
Claire (eng-runtime): Runtime flags to toggle for low-latency soak: continuous_batching=true, max_batch_ms=20, prefix_cache=true. Also enable kv-cache warmup before full load.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy to apac-southeast-3: service=runtime-api v=2.8.1 -> 2.9.0; canary=2 pods (10:02 UTC).
network-bot: Warning at 10:12 UTC: packet drops observed on node gpunode-12 (0.2%). Investigating NIC offload and MTU mismatch.
Ajay (eng-platform): Throttling load generator for now. Use this to reproduce CPU + batch pressure:
```bash
vegeta attack -rate=600 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | tee results.bin | vegeta report
```
Claire (eng-runtime): HPA/CA config we used in rehearsal:
```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: runtime-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: runtime-api
  minReplicas: 4
  maxReplicas: 80
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 50
```
Diego (eng-ops): Early signal: pod start latency spiking to ~18s on some nodes. Recommended immediate tweaks: bump podSpawnTimeout to 60s and lower max_pods_per_node to 8 for this soak. Also disable bursting autoscale policy for first 3 hours.
Maya (eng-infra): Noted. Applying podSpawnTimeout=60s; disabling burst mode now.
network-bot: FYI at 11:06 UTC: egress queue saturation on subnet b-az2, rate ~4.8Gbps, TCP retransmits rising. Suggest moving KV traffic to local replicas and reduce cross-AZ chatter.
Ajay (eng-platform): Reducing cross-AZ KV sync frequency from 15s -> 60s for soak. Pushing config change to canary.
Claire (eng-runtime): Observed tail latency during ramp #1: p99 rose from 220ms -> 1.1s when batch size hit 256. Mitigation: cap max_batch_size=128 and enable immediate flush for latency-critical routes.
Maya (eng-infra): Running targeted soak tests for node recovery: simulate node drain on two nodes (non-disruptive pods first). Command: kubectl drain gpunode-21 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
Diego (eng-ops): Node drain test passed but launch capacity slowed due to cloud instance provisioning limit (api rate throttling). Opened ticket with cloud support; temporary work-around: pre-create 6 spare VMs in standby pool.
Ajay (eng-platform): Cost guardrail check: pre-allocated standby adds ~12% to hourly spend. Approve for 4h emergency buffer?
Maya (eng-infra): Approve 4h buffer but enable tight budget alert: notify #finance if spend delta > $1,200 in 1h.
deploy-bot: Canary promotion: runtime-api v2.9.0 -> 30% traffic at 11:40 UTC.
network-bot: At 12:05 UTC packet drops resolved after MTU fix on gpunode-12. No further action.
Claire (eng-runtime): After fixes, p99 back to ~240ms with max_batch_size=128. Autoscaler scaled to 62 replicas at peak; we hit node provisioning soft-limit but recovered via standby pool.
Maya (eng-infra): Acceptance criteria check (quick):
- Autoscaler behaves without oscillation across two ramps: PASS
- p99 < 500ms for 90% of endpoints during sustained load: PASS (after tweaks)
- Node drain/recovery validated: PASS
- No persistent egress saturations after KV tuning: PASS
- Cost delta within approved buffer: approx +9% (within 4h buffer)
Maya (eng-infra): Handoff: @Ajay you own post-soak monitoring and the 3h rollback window. @Diego keep cloud ticket open for quota bump. I'll file a short postmortem with config diffs and recommended defaults for future region brings.
Ajay (eng-platform): Acknowledged. Will monitor dashboards and post summary in #eng-infra after 3h. :thumbsup:
Diego (eng-ops): Leaving standby pool at 15:40 UTC if no regressions.
Maya (eng-infra): Thanks everyone — good run. Will upload logs and the final checklist to the runbook link.
